title: 계획이 바뀌었어요: 하려다가 안 한 일
objective: By the end, you can use -(으)려다가 with different verb stems to explain a plan you changed or did not carry out.
summary: Learn -(으)려다가 to say you were going to do something but stopped or did something else instead.

task.title: Use -(으)려다가 correctly
task.line: Change the verb, choose the right form, or join the sentences so each one says what you planned and what happened instead.

forms.when: The verb stem ends in a vowel (가다, 타다, 전화하다).
forms.means: was going to do A, but (stopped and) did B / didn't do A
forms.example: 버스를 타려다가 길이 막혀서 지하철을 탔어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I was going to take the bus, but traffic was bad, so I took the subway.

forms.when: The verb stem ends in a consonant other than ㄹ (먹다, 읽다, 앉다).
forms.means: was going to do A, but did B instead
forms.exampleMeaning: I was going to have ramyeon for lunch, but I had gimbap instead.

forms.when: The verb stem ends in ㄹ (만들다, 열다, 팔다). Add -려다가 directly, with no 으.
forms.means: was going to do A, but changed the plan
forms.example: 케이크를 직접 만들려다가 시간이 없어서 그냥 샀어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I was going to make the cake myself, but I didn't have time, so I just bought one.

forms.when: Same meaning. 가 is often dropped in speech.
forms.means: was about to do A, but…
forms.example: 친구한테 전화하려다 너무 늦어서 문자를 보냈어요.
forms.exampleMeaning: I was about to call my friend, but it was too late, so I sent a text.

watchOut: 갔으려다가 (X) → 가려다가 (O): Do not put past tense before -(으)려다가. Put the past tense at the end of the sentence: 가려다가 안 갔어요.
만들으려다가 (X) → 만들려다가 (O): Stems ending in ㄹ take -려다가, not -으려다가.
듣으려다가 (X) → 들으려다가 (O): In ㄷ-irregular verbs (듣다, 걷다), ㄷ changes to ㄹ before 으.
운동하려다가 운동했어요 (X) → 운동하려다가 그냥 잤어요 (O): The second part must show that the first plan did not happen.
exercises: Fill in the blanks with -(으)려다가: ① 택시를 ____ 돈이 아까워서 걸어갔어요. (부르다) ② 책을 ____ 너무 졸려서 잤어요. (읽다)
Fill in the blanks with -(으)려다가: ① 창문을 ____ 밖이 추워서 안 열었어요. (열다) ② 손을 ____ 물이 차가워서 그냥 나왔어요. (씻다)
Choose the correct form: 운동화를 (샀으려다가 / 사려다가) 너무 비싸서 안 샀어요.
Choose the sentence that uses -(으)려다가 correctly: Ⓐ 메일을 보내려다가 메일을 보냈어요. Ⓑ 메일을 보내려다가 주소가 틀려서 다시 확인했어요.
Join the two sentences with -(으)려다가: 친구 생일에 꽃을 주려고 했어요. / 친구가 꽃을 안 좋아해서 책을 줬어요.
Rewrite 가져가려다가 with the short form -(으)려다: 우산을 가져가려다가 비가 그쳐서 그냥 나왔어요.
answers: 친구 생일에 꽃을 주려다가 친구가 꽃을 안 좋아해서 책을 줬어요.
